_about: US-40 AC13: the only roots tools/codex-review.mjs --include may copy from (the folder, or one inside it). A leading ~/ is the home directory; a * may stand in the last part. Only the copy committed at HEAD counts. Brad's ruling 2026-09-29: the Codex reviewer reads the knowledge-base raw sources and diff reports Claude reads; narrowed the same day to the dated refresh folders and the pathway raw; the supplements raw added once Brad took decision 3c (ConsumerLab proceeds at full scope).
_about_subjectRoots: US-40 AC15 (Brad 2026-10-05; adversary R1): a --subject, --baseline or --context file that is NOT tracked at HEAD must lie under one of these roots (absolute; a glob such as * or [0-9] may stand in the last part, and the folder it matches must be a real folder, not a file or a link); a tracked file is always allowed. Gitignored folders hold customer data (chatbot message exports, YouTube comment backups, Judge.me review exports), so only the numbered video FOLDERS are pinned: one to three digits, then a space ('38 end-of-obesity'), so output/0-private and loose files such as 'output/2026-10-05 judgeme.md' never match. Only the copy committed at HEAD counts.
_about_privateDeny: US-40 AC15 (2026-10-05): paths that never reach the reviewer, in EVERY mode: a --subject or --baseline matching one is a usage error; inside a --context folder it is withheld and counted; in the base snapshot (git archive) and in every patch it is excluded by pathspec, removed from the extracted tree, and asserted absent before Codex starts. Git glob syntax, matched case-insensitively against the repo-relative path and against every leading folder of it: a leading **/ matches at any depth, * never crosses a /. The union of this list at HEAD and in the working copy applies (an uncommitted edit can only add). Each entry and why: '**/comments-*' = YouTube comment dumps, author beside comment text (output/<N> <slug>/research/channel/comments-<videoId>.json and .txt; output/youtube/comments-backup*.json); '**/competitor-*-comments.*' = comment pulls from another channel's video (output/33 .../competitor-<videoId>-comments.md; not the wider '*-comments.*', which would swallow claude_business's tools/youtube-fix-comments.js); '**/objection-intel*' = objection notes that quote commenters' @handles beside their comment text; '**/research/channel/index.md' = the channel-research index, which quotes commenters' text verbatim with like counts; '**/*judgeme*.csv' = Judge.me raw review exports (customer emails and IP addresses; the anonymised docs/collector/reviews-weekly/reviews-anonymised.csv does not match); '**/chatbot_*/messages*' and '**/chatbot_*/conversations*' = chatbot conversation exports. Deliberately NOT '*.csv' (claude_business tracks 55 CSV ledgers and the roadmap 8, all reviewable) and NOT '*judgeme*' (tools/judgeme-reviews.js is code). Checked 2026-10-05: no file tracked in either repo matches.
